dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: These items are really hard to find...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Do you still remember the affair with the Jade Chamber? Baiwen came over some days ago, saying that a schedule's already been drawn up for its reconstruction.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: While it's impossible to finish building it so quickly, there are some small matters that can be prepared beforehand.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: She gave me a checklist and told me to look through the items and see what I can easily get hold of, but also that I needn't go out of my way to get them all.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: To be honest, though, I couldn't leave my post even if I wanted to. The Ministry of Civil Affairs is getting busier by the day, so I really don't know...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: It would be great if you had the time to help me make the trip. Baiwen did look like she was rather anxious for this to get done...

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: Let me see... Hmm, they first want a book called "Meadow of Gems," and some small bamboo ornaments.

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: You can ask Jifang about the book. As for the bamboo ornaments, I believe that Master Lu of Fanmu Carpenter's makes them.

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: I'm sorry, but I'll have to leave this matter in your hands. Hmm, but it would indeed be good if the Jade Chamber could be rebuilt...

choices.text: You're really rebuilding the Jade Chamber?

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: I've heard Baiwen say that the schedule's already been sent out. But given how large that building is, I think that it will take some time to rebuild it...

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: They're just preparing some small items at the moment. Things will really get busy once they officially start the rebuilding process.
